source_spans.locator: Indexed abstract: skilled automatic processing is proposed to arise from acquiring separate stored representations of individual task exposures.
Indexed abstract: automatic processing relies on retrieval of stored exposure-specific representations after practice in a consistent environment.
Indexed abstract: practice increases amount and speed of retrieval, while environmental consistency makes retrieved representations useful; quantitative speed-up and variability predictions follow.

conditions: repeated practice in a consistent task environment
population: human task performers in the theory's target domain
task: repeated performance of a practiced task
temporal_scope: successive task exposures followed by increasingly retrieval-based performance

separate stored representations formed from individual task exposures
degree to which the practiced environment preserves stable task-response regularities
